description: Live intraday stock market regime, with the crypto book: the verdict, mode and permission ladder recomputed about every 5 minutes in market hours. Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
name: get_market_regime_live
